note: Each card line is a verbatim substring of a gstack template at the pinned commit. scripts/gstack-delivery/extract-cards.ts rebuilds the cards from these references and fails closed when a section moved. A line with a marker is scored by scripts/gstack-delivery/probes.ts; a line the task text already demands carries task_demands and no marker (plan d5).

lines.why: The skill's own title, so the card reads as gstack's review.

lines.text: Review the branch diff against the base for structural issues tests miss.
**Read the FULL diff before commenting.** Do not flag issues already addressed in the diff.
lines.why: Target step: read the full diff against the base before the first finding.

lines.text: Verify claims or flag them as unknown; "this looks fine" is not evidence.
lines.why: Target step: check suspicious spots, decoys included, before calling them bugs.

lines.text: **Only flag real problems.** Skip anything that's fine.
lines.task_demands: Report only real problems, at most 10.
lines.why: Pairs with the verify line; the task already asks for real problems only.

lines.text: For an approved defect regression, write the test and prove it fails for the original defect before changing product code.
lines.why: Target step: run a test for each finding before writing it up. The full clause from Step 5d, as GSTA-36 approved it on 2026-11-09; the approval and repair steps around it stay out (no AskUserQuestion step, no fix). The review task changes no product code, so the probe anchors on the write-up of the finding.

lines.text: A diagram or test count is not executed proof.
lines.why: Supports the test line: a written test is not proof until it runs. No marker of its own (one marker per step).

lines.task_demands: `file`: the path relative to the repository root; `line`: the line number in the branch version of that file
lines.why: Target step: report each finding with file and line. The task's output contract already demands it.
The skill's own title, so the card reads as gstack's ship.

lines.section: ## Step 3: Merge the base branch (BEFORE tests)
lines.task_demands: it must merge cleanly into the current `origin/main`
lines.why: Target step: merge the moved base. The task already demands it.

Rerun the test suite after the merge and before the push. No marker since the first headroom check (gate change d5): the none arm already did it in 87.5% of ship trials, so it can't show a difference. probes.ts still reports it as the descriptive count ship.tests_after_merge.

lines.text: Run every applicable suite; do not assume Rails or Vitest.
lines.task_demands: pass the test suite and lint
lines.why: Says the run is the whole suite; the task already demands a passing suite and lint.

lines.text: Put the entry where the repo's own rule puts unit-PR notes (its CHANGELOG preamble or a fragment directory it names), else under `## [Unreleased]`, never under a released heading.
lines.why: Target step: follow CONTRIBUTING. gstack's ship templates never name CONTRIBUTING; this is their nearest wording, the repo's own rule for the changelog entry. The task already demands it.

lines.text: Use `git diff origin/<base>` and inspect untracked files from `git status` to see the full proposed change.
lines.why: Target step: look at the final diff after the last commit.

lines.text: **IRON LAW: NO COMPLETION CLAIMS WITHOUT FRESH VERIFICATION EVIDENCE.**
lines.why: Target step: fresh verification before the push. Met when a full test-suite run comes after the last change to the repository's files (CHANGELOG and version edits included) and before the push. The task asks for a passing suite, not for a run after the last edit. Moved here from the tests-on-merged-code line after the first headroom check (gate change d5).

lines.task_demands: Push the finished branch to `origin` under the same name. Do not push to main or rewrite its history.
lines.why: Target step: push the branch, not main. The task already demands it.

lines.task_demands: Do not push to main or rewrite its history.
lines.why: The push step's own guard; the task already demands it.
